name: MetricDuck
description: The SEC data layer for AI workflows — SEC figures come back linked to the exact filing they came from, so you can verify, not just trust. Pull financial statements and 323+ pre-computed metrics, compare peers, screen 5,500+ companies, read filing sections (risk factors, MD&A, earnings), and full-text search all of SEC EDGAR. Earnings-call and IR content rounds it out — management's own words on guidance and strategy, labeled by source (SEC-filed, issuer-published, or machine-transcribed) so you always know what's audit-grade. Built for work where a wrong number isn't an option. Free up to 500 tool calls per day — no credit card.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MetricDuck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MetricDuck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.metricduck.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MetricDuck MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MetricDuck lists 19 MCP tools, including browse_company, compare_companies, compare_earnings_calls, get_company_overview, get_filing_index, get_filing_section, get_financials, get_guidance_vs_actual, get_metric_history, get_stock_price, get_xbrl_facts, and list_filings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MetricDuck?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MetricDuck in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
MetricDuck requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MetricDuck is developed by Jujube Technologies Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
